violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage links in the hot holding unit were 122ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The person in charge corrected this by reheating the sausage links. CDI.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. There is an unapproved splitter installed on the mop sink spigot.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. The EHS provided the person in charge with an appropriate backflow prevention device for this application (a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve), which they will order and install as soon as received. The person in charge disconnected the unapproved splitter during the inspection. Please let you EHS know when the new splitter is installed, which can be done by sending a picture of it installed. CDI.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed the food service employee washing, towel drying and stacking pans, without washing hands and donning gloves when handling the clean utensils.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM educated the food service employee on the proper methods for washing and handling utensils, washing hands and donning gloves in between. The dishes were rewashed, rinsed and sanitized.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: the dishes removed from the dish machine and dried with a towel were not properly dried or sanitized, due to the high temperature dish machine not reaching the appropriate temperature on the dish plate. The temperature registered at 155F.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM had the food service employee rewash, rinse and sanitize the utensils, using the 3 compartment sink set up. The CFM placed a work order for the repairs.

violations.title: Cooking Raw Animal Foods, Minimum of 155F
violations.observation: The following comminuted or ground meat, fish, or game animal was not cooked to a sufficient temperature and/or time to eliminate pathogenic bacteria: cheese burger at grill (127F)
violations.corrective_action: The food service employee cooked the cheeseburger back on the grill until it reached a temperature of 158F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Greek yogurt (50F, 50F), hard boiled egg (50F) in Open Air display cooler; potato salad (65F), chicken salad (52F) in McCall 2 DR at pizza station.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection. The McCall 2 DR and the open air display refrigeration units were both taken out of commission until repairs can be made. The facility has ample refrigeration units.
